tools.name: searchpipe_search
tools.description:
Run an AI-powered web search for a query: multi-engine retrieval → page fetching → LLM reranking → optional AI answer.

Uses the same commercial pipeline and accepts the same parameters as the HTTP POST /search endpoint:
authentication → rate limiting → input moderation → credit charge → search → ou

tools.name: searchpipe_verify
tools.description:
Verify a factual claim against retrieved evidence: claim in, verdict out — a four-label judgment (supported / partial / unsupported / inconclusive), not generated text.

Every result ships with verifiable evidence — span-level quotes, claim verdicts, and source authority — not just links.

tools.name: searchpipe_account_balance
tools.description:
Check the remaining credit balance for this API key — free to call, no credits charged and no usage logged.

Returns the same fields as the REST GET /v1/account/balance endpoint: `balance`
(total remaining credits, 2 decimal places), `permanent` (recharge/bonus credits that
never expire), `expiring`

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_verify, searchpipe_account_balance · Private data: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_verify, searchpipe_account_balance · Public sink: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_verify, searchpipe_account_balance · Destructive: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_account_balance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_verify, searchpipe_account_balance · Private data: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_verify, searchpipe_account_balance · Public sink: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_verify, searchpipe_account_balance · Destructive: searchpipe_search, searchpipe_account_balance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "searchpipe_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
